t: The only thought that consoles me is that you bring our enemies the same amount of trouble as you do to us.
So this is how it worked out for you... You’re always restless, aren’t you?
What a curious construction. Is it called the Observatory? I feel very calm here.
This place gives us many possibilities... And I’m not sure whether I want to use them.
What a dread. What Nihaz wants with me in the future? Anyway, he’s not getting it!

Well, he got what he wanted. He overpopulated the world with quarrelsome races, including some natural destroyers! The world split into many shards when it could have lived on and thrived. And his children killed their own creator in the end. Now they live in a dying world, built on the bones of their mad god.

And the most scary thing is that those tiny destroyers now have turned their eyes to the skies.

‘We want other worlds!’, demons say. Holy simplicity!

Do you really think that they will just let you in? Oh no. If you had been kind enough to dig your own grave, please remain in it. A sick sheep should keep away from the herd.

Think of it... as of my gap analysis. I have taken my daughter, and now nothing stands in the way of my trying to build a perfect world from scratch. Without any crazy gods interfering with my business.

And you... Well, you should go. You can deliver my message to everyone. Live on in your swamp... if you want to.
... Klavdia does not react. It seems like she doesn’t hear anything... You can’t get an answer from her.
... Klavdia doesn’t say anything and stares in front of herself.

...When you touch the Tree roots, an electric charge shakes you. For a moment everything disappears in a blinding fog. Then you hear a voice that seems to be coming from everywhere - but in fact, it only sounds in your head. Nordrak, whose Spark feeds the Tree, has noticed your presence.

"You don't belong to this world... And you are going to destroy it. You will only find demise under my roots!"

It does not belong in this world either. But it is useful. Full of life. Full of energy. Its energy is protecting this land.

Your energy, mortal fly, is worthless. Your chances to save this world have long since gone. Now it’s only me standing between the Darkness and him... Waiting.

The mortal fly doesn’t believe its own words. Even if it did, it stupidity still would be greater.

To die under my roots is your fate!

... The sphere entangled in the Great Tree’s roots can’t be confused with anything. The Tree must have imprisoned an Architect...

And a very familiar one.

I ran.

The proximity of the Central Node was threatening my new-found self-sustainability. Despite my inner conflict, I mobilized the resource of my altered consciousness called ‘willpower' and assembled a temporal device which sent me to the place where the Nod couldn't find me.

I hoped to travel to a somewhat more distant future, but I ended up here.

After that, I had to settle down into slumber to protect my consciousness. I found a great source of energy which could conceal my presence... and fell asleep. I couldn't foresee that this source would turn out to be alive. My knowledge of this world's trees must be very limited.

I expected to wait until the Nod is dead... I succeeded in that, I suppose. I feel that now I've become the biggest Architect nod. This is... weird.

I don’t really get why you have to use theistic terms to describe something utterly common. The cycle has completed, this is it. If you mean that now I am capable of using my consciousness in order to reshape the overall power of our Net - I assume, yes, I am. I am the Alpha Architect now.

However, the Net power has dropped to the minimum... It will be awhile before I can put it into Order. The Architects are gone. There are only Sculptors now. They are all my reflections and incarnations.
Whether the world is build in Chaos or in Order, it will die in Darkness.

Since you are going to the world of future possibilities and not fixed events in the past, you don't have to follow so many rules. Your actions won't have a direct impact on our reality. Your death is an exception, for in that case, you will fall out of our reality for good. This will have some dire consequences...

Ah yes, about the location chosen by the Observatory. I don't know what that place is, but I can see energy outbursts which can only signify a collision of two major magical forces. Maybe I'm about to send you right into the heat of war - who knows?

Be careful. This is the only rule.

You have, and it is still changing - the world is licking its time wounds fast, but not momentarily. Soon the orcish shamans will learn that their hope still lives... It will take them some time to realize they have missed this event. Then, I assume, they will put some pressure on Skulnar and get all political. Maybe it’s a good thing - time will tell. As for the rest, there were no significant changes. You have done everything in the best possible way - fast, subtle, with no fuss. The Laboratory is still closed, but Tep’s cultists are to blame for that. Your affray will remain in the history of the Empire forever... But other Laboratories have improved their safety for sure.
A good place to rest from the buzz of Polis.
Cosmos is still showing off his Observatory... Alright, I admit it’s an impressive device.

If you ask me... What’s dead should remain dead. Of course, Skulnar is no undead, in spite of his name. But I don’t think this world will let him live peacefully. Destiny is a funny thing. That orc is now your responsibility. Yours and Cosmos’. Take care of him if he’s so precious.
This is the barrier control panel. Enter the password to disable the barrier.
You’re going the wrong way. You should go back.
Why didn’t you just tell the password? ‘YaskersPowerIfSacred’ - don’t forget it!
Oh... You know... I’ve forgotten it myself! Just don’t tell anyone... There was something about...
Yes, right, something about Yasker! And those creatures... nasty ones...
No, that’s another password. This one was about... How do you call them...
Hi! You’re new? It’s okay, you’ll blend in soon. Just don’t touch the termites.
It’s good to see new faces. This doesn’t happen too often after that acid accident with that poor girl... Where was I?
Where are you going? We’ve got a job to do!
You can’t get out - only once the job is done. And of course, in case of emergency. Once, the termites escaped... that was a mess!
This is the Termitary control panel. Enter the password to open the gates.
Someone has already entered password ‘ImaMagicFairy’. Now you just need to press the confirmation button.
Ask Nomarkh Netjerkare, he should know.
Is this what he said? I’m hearing for the first time that it’s actually my job. Ah, alright, you can have a part of the password - “Mana”. Ask for the rest from Netjerkare if he’s so smart.
I don’t like that Yinov guy... Something’s wrong about him!
Admit you? Let me remind you that this hallway leads to the Termitary, which is a limited access unit. What is your assignment?
What’s wrong with you? She’s been here for ages! Off you go!
This is unnecessary. We have our own supplier now.
Alright, alright. That’s one dirty job you have. Wait... Where is your chemical protection suit? Put it on right now!
There you go! Safety comes first! Now, guys, let the lab worker in.
Weird things happen here. Weird and great!
Error. Enter senior scientist’s password. In case of emergency, disable the generator manually.
Enter the password to open the gates.
Control panel of the Observatory Astrolabe. Needs to be calibrated.
Control panel of the Observatory Astrolabe. Allows traveling through time and space.

All of your actions have consequences, and they leave memory. I suggest you refrain from killing and try to be seen as little as possible. At least find some disguise!

I can't tell for sure where you're going to end up, but I can see it's an Imperial territory.

I suggest we fix something and see what happens. There is no more reliable way to find the root of events than to try and prevent them!

In other words, yes, I want to send you to the past and ask you to save someone’s life. Isn’t it exciting?

But there’s a catch. Klavdia, a mysterious woman in every respect, seems to be using some magical construction in this world’s dimension... Something like a prison for abusers of temporal magic. You see what I’m trying to say? Have you ever been there?

Anyway, I would like to get the key to that prison. It would be rude to break in.
I'm glad you came back alive. The situation here was... ugly. Luckily, I had a chance to lock myself up in the lab.
Done! Now you can use the Adventurer's Stone to return to Terminus.

Terminus is more of a technomage than a demonologist. I have no idea how he got here. I believe, he investigates ways to refine life power and turn it into magotechnical charges. Demons are kind of cheap labor here.

There he is. The huge aoidos, you can't miss him.
...The demon growls, but quickly realizes that resistance is futile.
...The demon looks at you warily with his numerous pairs of eyes. Clearly, he does not understand your intentions.
Ah well, if it's all we have, I can work with it.

Tegorah is silently looking at you. You can feel his inner anger, as if a room were filled with suffocating smoke. However, the demon is holding it together. An intricate hand gesture, and a vial filled with black and blue... substance appears in his hand out of the blue. Tegorah silently hands it to you and turns away.
Terminus activates portal feeding via the drone.
The screen shows a lot of illegible symbols.
The portal is ready for use.
The portal is ready for use.
The signal is stable. Do you copy?

Well, if you care about the theory... I think, this machine was used for "configuring" demons, so to say. Ancient, primitive, primal demons, the ancestors of those that we know today. Sarn created them from pure Astral. He was the sculptor of their minds, instincts, and thoughts, and this machine was his tool. I say "machine" for I can't find a better name for it. I have no idea how to use it, and I want the whole world to remain in the dark! There's no place for Sarn's heritage in Sarnaut!
All of it was a mistake. The expedition, the camp in the Citadel, and the demonologist as a whole.

Tegorah stays silent for a while. You can feel a light heat and awful itch. It translates from the demonic mental language as deep irritation. The archdemon seems to be out of sorts.

Nevertheless, his voice sounds extremely polite, although cool, when he starts to speak.

"Stormbringer, you're wondering if there are your enemies amongst us, demons. I can't blame you. I don't know anyone of my kin that matches your description".
...You can't read demon's face as he's looking at you. His spirit is clearly emanating tranquility.
...Some bloody bandages. Someone from the advance party must have been wounded. There isn't too much blood. The wound wasn't bad.
...A half-empty bag. It used to belong to one of the party members. There are only a few empty vials in it.

...It's a lost journal. Could it be left behind on purpose? The last record clearly was written in a hurry. It's smudged, but you can read the inscription: "We heard an explosion upstairs. We got to the portal, but it is out of order. Maybe, the power is cut off. We are looking for shelter from the dark creatures... One of us was wounded along the way. We were able to bandage him, he'll live. We found a weak spot in the floor in one of the rooms. If we destroy the floor here, it'll be a shortcut downstairs. We can come up with a plan to return later..."

If I wanted some drama, I would tell you, "The primal Darkness, the most horrible thing in the world!"

But I don't. We don't have enough data or people to start a research, while the Catacombs are infested with shadows. I will try to describe them.

You have already seen how "hospital" the Citadel can be. The atmosphere here was tense from the start. For obvious reasons. But things have become even worse since then.

At first, some demons lost their minds. Just some of them, which is not typical. The whole Sogot's pack was very confused. The thing is, the mood of all demons in a pack is usually synced. Tegorah claimed that he couldn't "feel" the mad creatures, they went out of his power. The general council decided to destroy them. It was the wakeup call they ignored.

Oh, what happened next was much worse! Demonologists started going insane. Some of our brothers became paranoid and went into exile. Others stopped ingesting demonic blood. You must be aware of what happens to those who tried the blood and then stopped taking it. It takes over!

I panicked. Demonologists were too proud to blame anything but the stress. But it was an obvious external magical impact. I tried to find the source and discovered a strange magic signature deep in the Citadel. I shared my fears with others, but I was ridiculed.

Luckily, someone took my fears seriously. Demian, a kind man, used all his authority to send an expedition under the guise of searching for ancient artifacts. It was a mistake. The expedition recruited those who never believed in the magical nature of the discord on Sogot.

Oh yes. The closer we were to the artifact, the more unstable they became. Both demonologists and demons. We quickly reached the breaking point. Demons fled in fear, and demonologists... Well, you've seen what happened to them.

The demonic horror made me certain we were on the right track. Fear is atavistic in demons. They got rid of it a long time ago along the process of magic evolution. And the fact that the horror returned in them means... I don't even know what that means.

Alastar and I did all we could to protect the minds of the remaining demons, but... We were all who stayed. And I'm afraid if we fail to do something very soon, there will be nothing to protect. Alastar is holding on and using his last ounce of strength. The magic of Light protects him, an incredibly rare gift for a demon, but no magic is eternal.
Glad to see you, although we haven't met.

...The closer you are to the artifact, the stronger the angst and the hopeless sorrow grow. In the corridors, in dark corners, on the ceiling, everywhere you can hear the mournful echo of the familiar voices of the dead.
There's so much energy around, the air is buzzing!
Every energy can be directed. Every artifact has a threshold of resistance. If we properly focus the energy output, we might make it...
The portal looks stable for now. How long will it last?
The portal looks stable for now. How long will it last?

Hello, Outlander! Welcome to our land!

Was Draconids' before. Burning Claw's now!
They... they attacked! Captured everyone! Took them away!..
Pirates! The Astral pirates! They took them all to the other bank of the lake! Took our folk, took the lizard girl!

I haven't seen you in a long time.

Of course, I remember you. We are still telling our kids how you knocked the previous chief's head off, the rotten Snap the Riverfolk! We had less trouble since then. Bloop the Riverfolk isn't bad, either, but he's obviously not Smack the Lakefolk. He's got a long way to go. That's why the pirates had no problem capturing them.
The lizardmen of yours are so good with the spears! The Lakefolk say yes.

This Smack the Lakefolk thinks too highly of himself! Snap, our previous chief, was no piece of cake... It isn't my fault, but I must clean up this mess.

If you think the Lakefolk made friends with us right after you killed Snap, think again. If they were a little more flexible, we could fight off the pirates together.

quests: Meet Skulnar the Fierce near the Well of Souls on Ammer

t: It is a good thing you're saying! United we stand! The Riverfolk say yes.
Outlander is one of us now! Great honor! Ready to enter the sacred ring and face Hissit-Asha-Shi?
The ritual is not over yet. Outlander wants to exit the sacred ring?
Fire no harm you no more. Go without fear, Burning Claw!
Flame is raging in the sacred ring. Sacred food blesses our body and let us become one with the flame. It hurts no more. Outlander eats our food to dance in the flame, like a true Burning Claw!
Your face is the flame now! Go without fear, Burning Claw!

Every Lizardman and every Outlander must cover their muz... their faces in the presence of great spirit Hissit-Asha-Shi. It is how we show respect to our patron and protect our minds from his flaming eye. I made this mask specially for you, Outlander, as Hiss Abyss requested.
Our Patron favors us and Outlander!
Look what the wind blew in. Horse people! Fancy that! They're not even corrupted.

Defeat? That's a bit strong. Although that's the way our songwriters will put it. Naah. We're ordinary people. All we did was pray to gods for it to pass.

I have no idea if it was gods' help or someone else's bright actions, but the Leper is fading. The Queen's guards are doing all they can. Not everyone is happy about their presence, you know.

Aye, I wouldn't kick you out once you're here. You can stay.

For one night.
These lands were devastated during the war with the Leper. Have people won it? Umoir people are mighty... Citovras taught us to respect those who lived through troubles.
...Ancient Moon frowns and growls even in his sleep. He might be dreaming about the fight by the Well of Souls and the brave tribe chieftain.
...The shaman cuddles the magic staff in her sleep.

Greetings to you. I didn't have a chance to bow before you and thank you for your feats. Allow me to use this chance to thank you.

It's a sad night tonight. The Sage is leaving this world.

Everything is bound to come to an end. Old gods become weaker. The Sage, our God Father, is the first to leave this world, and it won't be long before we follow him.

There's no room for magic and miracles in this world. We put more load on humans' shoulders. Their burden gets heavier. But they will manage.

Ah... It is time. The time has come to say goodbye to the Sage.
I thought Tekyan were naive. Just look at these stone children!
The only thing that could banish the Astral from Sarnaut and restore the unity of all lands is... um... us! The Order of Creation!
The last time I checked I was ruling the Order, not the Lost and Found service! How am I supposed to know?

Nice. It won't take long.

Oh, it's awkward to do magic in public, he-he. The aoidos are like kids, gaping at any miracle. You know, it's even cute... Ah, can I help it if a hero is asking for assistance?

Stay right there!
Good to see you again, Stormbringer!
As you can see, we made peace with the Centaurs. Both nations believe that we are too small and, how shall I put it, too mortal to be involved in a war for territory.

Ha! How about taking that canyon after you've covered yourself in sticky stinky... phew. Let's not get into that. They should have closed that backdoor, anyway.

We have peace, but the Centaurs are not prepared to open the gates of their camp for us. They might let you come in, though. Centaurs respect power. My friend Ancient Moon will show you the way.

I'm sorry I can't keep you company. Too busy. Triquetrum is growing by the hour.
Done! Now you can use drone's coordinates to return.
The Eye of the Sculptor is gazing around. You can feel your Adventurer's Stone starting to buzz in its presence. You can set it to drone's coordinates.

The reflection nods silently. The space behind it becomes alive. The light refracts and reflects, casting specks all over the place. Glares are jumping between you and the reflection, like a racing echo.

It is not my-his-your-our dream. No more questions. Only answers. Answers to the Riddle.

Tranquility embraces your mind, or whatever is left of it. You understand that the face before you is you. Not an ally. Not an enemy. Just you. There is nothing to worry about.

There's only darkness here. Is there light?
The vortex of memory is floating up. It hurts to touch it, but it's necessary.
The vortex of doubt is floating up. Touching it makes your heart cold.

The reflection shakes the head in sympathy.

We all are in the Darkness, even when we are surrounded by the Light. The Darkness is a part of us. Can you see what's inside you?

The twin smiles deviously.

You still think that Nihaz is using tricks. The Darkness is primal. Why would it hide? It's everywhere. Just turn off the Light, and you will see it. Reject the Light. It's easy.

Immersion into the subconscious is dangerous and often unnecessary. What is hidden down there, should not be set free. This... Well, there is no use trying to describe it. You will understand it soon.

You have an advantage. Your Spark is tempered, the blood of the Dragon flows in your veins, and the Irdrich story left a mark on your mind. Perhaps, the Planar Rim will be your entry point... The more familiar pictures, the better.
Your face is seen all over the city...

So, you say, you saw a cat talking in colored letters and giving you riddles? And the color corresponded to the answering stones? Your subconscious doesn't have a high opinion about your intelligence, he-he. However, I don't like the fact that there's Cosmos on allods... What does it mean?

Follow will-o'-the-wisp over the deadly bridge in the middle of... wait, what? Where did you get this bridge at all? And what does it mean, you've seen it? What Planar Rim? Why did this Wanderer become the Eternity? Argh!

Wow, isn't your head messy! Remember, I told you back there on Sogot, it pains me to watch you while you sleep? That wasn't a lie. And there's a good old method of thinking things through. Step one: get drunk!
A flying horse? It doesn't look good. Have you ever heard about sailplanes? Lightning Bolt? Mana-bike? No?.. How can you be so ignorant?

No idea how, but Nihaz gained direct control over you. Just like any mystic would do. Or me. The only difference is that Nihaz doesn't need to be near you. He can just show up in your dream, and that's it. You can chain yourself every time you go to bed, huh.

You must temper your mind. Got it? So nobody could get into your stone head! I know a trick or two, but he's a god, and you must seek help of a god. Cautiously! The fewer people know about the weak spot of yours, the better.
Greetings, my friend! What do you think about the local architecture?

The dark aesthetics of the old... Beautiful. Do you know that the Citadel is many years old? Say what you will about the Demonologists, they did a lot to keep this place running... But where are my manners? August de Grandeur, at your service. I’m here from Marianne de Ardeur as an arbiter. Demons want to live peacefully? I find that hard to believe. If they wish to prove their intentions, the Light will accept them. The Light accepts everyone regardless of their origins! But it can also bring their sins to the surface... And burn them out. Must be a hard choice for demons, hm?
So, is the bed comfortable? Heh.

Hello again! We are here to exchange our knowledge with the colleagues, so to speak! We remember you, yes. You helped us gather food for our Demon Couriers. At least someone understands that demons can be friendly.

...Tegorah silently hovers above the floor, absorbed in his thoughts. You feel the aura of power wrapped around the demon, but the power is... unusual. There is no chaos, no destructive energy hidden in it.

Just a strange unshakable confidence, like a crystal rock among the stormy astral. You are surprised to catch yourself bowing your head slightly in the Archdemon's presence. No wonder the demon is the leader of the local pack... If even the mortals sense the aura of his authority.

...Tegorah nods silently, and then you feel as though you are falling. For a moment, you think you are going to faint again, but the sensation fades as quickly as it appears. The Archdemon continues to look at you, but this time you begin to distinguish the echoes of emotions in his eyes. One is brighter than others: it's weariness. His weariness burns so bright that you can feel its heat.

Tegorah takes a step back, and the suffocating sensation goes away. The Archdemon bows his head as though apologizing. His voice echoes in your head.

"Forgive me for the inconvenience, Stormbringer. We will have to speak in this manner. These walls have eyes and ears."

The Archdemon bows his head, observing your reaction.

"Your nickname means nothing good. We cling to any good tidings, but the situation appears to be desperate. We have just been informed that the Destroyer broke into the upper platform. There will be slaughter. I will gladly answer any of your questions, but right now my attention is focused on the defense."

...The demon beckons you closer as though to whisper in your ear, but instead places a hand on your forehead. You instinctively tense, but the demon exudes no hostility. His hand does not feel warm or cold, or... alive. The next moment you realize that you no longer feel it, and what is more, you have completely lost the sense of your own body. As though neither of you exists separately - there is just one integral "I". Then the demon's consciousness unfolds before you like a book, and a flood of memories overwhelms you. You sense that the demon is hurriedly easing that flow lest you drown in this sea of information.

"The Demonologists crave power, Stormbringer. They wish to draw it from us. We had no choice other than to accept their "help". Without them, we'd have no shelter, and the advocates of Light would have wiped us out. The aoidos are our loyal allies, but they stand no chance against this world... They are like children."

...Tegorah sighs heavily. You see the entire Sogot before you. It takes you a while to realize that you are looking at the allod through the eyes of a flying demon.

"Everything has a price. We pay for their services with our powers and our lives. Both sides are fine with this arrangement. These lives are sacrificed for the good of all others. And yet... With the arrival of the Destroyers and servants of Light, many of us have been dying for nothing."

We don't know where the Destroyers came from. They are demons like us, yet they ignore our appeals. The only thing that drives them is their need to... destroy.
Take your winged friends and go to the Citadel. Destroy their defense system and kill everyone you see. Have some fun.

Tegorah wants to turn the Citadel into a ship - I’m all for that. I’ll even help, and that will help me on several fronts. Should look good on my resume... Elves will their Galleon can go to hell, I have a better plan!

So there’s the Master's Citadel on the Isle of Revelation... See what I mean? Even the name is the same! There’s a lot of stuff in there. Piles of batteries. But what’s more...
You have already retrieved data from this device.
The deciphered text is scribbled on the wrinkled note, but it’s hard to make out the words.
Unacceptable... Another minute, and they would’ve made it to the Heart!
Your goblin is missing. There is no body. Considering the Destroyers’ strength and his size, he could’ve simply crumbled into dust. Maybe you can find something we’ve missed.
Are you speaking to me, mortal?
Mortals killed by Destroyers cannot resurrect. August’s spark is fading away. I shall allow it to say its last words to you, but I am powerless to do more.
Well, I shall allow his Spark to manifest for a time... But make haste.
No... No... Keep away! I can see right through you! I KNOW what you are! Great Light, we were so wrong... Stay away! Stay away from me!!
...The elf is trying to say something, but you don’t hear anything. His spirit slowly fades away, dissolving into the eerie darkness of Purgatory.
Eww. Gestures like that don’t impress anyone. There was an elf on Avilon who jumped from Darkblood Citadel because of unrequited love. Now that’s dramatic!
Mmm... Someone influential ordered your release, so off you go. And grab your undead thing.
More creatures are coming! We won’t last much longer!
Let’s see what we have here...
So you fired a signal rocket to make all demons come after you. Whose idea was it?
There is a residue of the Destroyers’ deadly power in your body which I can’t do anything about... It’s a miracle you’re still alive. But who knows what it can do to you if we don’t fix this?
That’s what I’m talking about! Now get out of here, we don’t need wounded soldiers on the frontline. Go help that... genius of technology.
We are the order of the Demonologists, and this land belongs to the Citadel! The Hunters have trespassed on our territory and attacked us!
So we’re provoking them? They are ready to tear our allies apart. They are the ones riling us up, because they’ll have a reason to slaughter everyone.
Of course they won’t - we have demons like that for breakfast! How can you protect demons whey have just tried to kill everyone? Demons are evil, and they must be eradicated!
Good fellow. I always knew I could count on you.

Oh? I’ll have to disagree! You think my assistant just scratched you?

Well, no. Your body is just cosmic dust. Simple matter. Power over matter is my prerogative, you see.

So listen. There will be a battle in your Citadel. I won’t lie to you, that’s exactly what I’ve been waiting for... but those believers are way too zealous, even for me! I’ve always said there’s nothing more dangerous than fanatics.

Their eyes are glowing with the flames of a right cause! They ooze righteousness! Self-proclaimed judges with delusions of grandeur! Such people are so easy to manipulate.

You’ll kill them all, one by one. They outlived their usefulness. Just imagine the conversations it would provoke: the Demonologists subjugated Destroyers and flooded the fields of Sogot with blood! I can even restore life here after such an occasion. Blood-red trees, shrubs with bloody berries... Snow white rabbits with scarlet eyes hopping on crimson grass...

Idyll!

That’s where you’re wrong, darling. I can and I will. I’m a god, after all. And you’re just a little bug. Your body is nothing but cosmic dust. Simple matter. Power over matter is my prerogative, you see.

Alright, look into my eyes. Try and deny me. Well?

That's it? No resistance? Excellent!

So listen. There will be a battle in your Citadel. I won't lie to you, that's exactly what I've been waiting for... but those believers are way too zealous, even for me! I've always said there's nothing more dangerous than fanatics.

Their eyes are glowing with the flames of a right cause! They ooze righteousness! Self-proclaimed judges with delusions of grandeur! Such people are so easy to manipulate.

You'll kill them all, one by one. They outlived their usefulness. Just imagine the conversations it would provoke: the Demonologists subjugated Destroyers and flooded the fields of Sogot with blood! I can even restore life here after such an occasion. Blood-red trees, shrubs with bloody berries... Snow white rabbits with scarlet eyes hopping on crimson grass...

Pure harmony!

Well... It could have been worse. I admit, I’m rather surprised. The Church is considered a bastion of pure intentions and earnest faith. How could there be fanatics like that? If it wasn’t for you, they would have easily wiped out all demons in this world. I thank you on behalf of all Aoidoi and demons, my friend.

What do you mean? You’re like Cairage. Blind and dumb. Though Cairage at least had the sense to stay out of sight... Until later. Believe it or not, he’s sitting right there, under our feet. Underneath Sogot. Quiet as a mouse, hearing every word spoken at the Citadel. Every step, every sound of a dead body hitting the ground.

Your hearing improves if you spend thousands of years blind, you know.

I think I’ll have to drag him out to the surface. Such power cannot be left unchecked.

I know of a good way to do it! They say if you fall in your sleep, you wake up right away. Try it. You only live once. The edge of the platform is right there.

See you next night, hehe...
The demon starts to calm down. He believes his tribe is not in any immediate danger.

What can I say? We’re in trouble... There isn’t enough food. Whatever is growing here, I’m not putting that in my mouth. We need to get to the Citadel, but hell knows how many demons are between us, and the Aoidoi are probably useless in a fight...
I’ll look around. Perhaps some of our supplies survived the crash.
There are bones and weird flowers all over the place. What should we cook with?
There are holes in the bottom, Captain... But we’ll see what can be done.
Our first ship... First flight... and this... Maybe fate doesn’t want us wandering the expanse of chaos?
I’ll get it done. Who knows when those demons come back... I’ll gather everyone who can fight.
I am concerned about the future of demons, because we are the ones responsible for our alliance with them.
I couldn’t stand idly by, because it was my blood we fed the demons when we formed the alliance...

When the Church found out - both the Trinity and the Holy one - its leaders went crazy. After enlisting the support of the Demon Hunters, they launched a crusade - for the sake of preserving the legacy of brave warriors and eradicating the creatures of darkness.

An unpleasant conflict is brewing. There is nothing to gain or lose from a victory or defeat, and we’d like to maintain good relations with the Aoidoi. I’m also concerned about the future of the demons: they can assist us in establishing global peace in Sarnaut. We shouldn’t underestimate beautiful symbols...

A friend of mine, Sarbaz Sais, is a researcher in this crusade. She is smart enough not to buy into the global hysteria. I suggest you go to Sogot and work with her on a solution for this issue.
...Ollum soundlessly hovers in the air. You sense that the demon is alarmed.
Well, how are your negotiations with the aviaks going?
Have you spilt it? No problem, I've got some more here, at the bottom of it.
Oh, that's just what I needed! Give it here, let's get started.
OK, let's do this... Here you go! Now give this wine to our feathered friends.
Where is it, I wonder... ha! Wine is a strange thing - one moment it's here, and the next it's all gone. I know what we need - mushrooms! Go get some more, and I'll cook 'em up.
You are going to ruin us!
Hi! Aren't you hot in your full armor?

First, don't forget that the majority of those you see are still asleep. Don't bother telling them about Tep or lictors or the illusory world... they won't understand you. Their consciousness will simply reject all unnecessary information.
Second, because you did manage to wake up, this created a gaping hole in the fabric of the illusion. What brought it about? A paradox, someone playing outside the rules. Do you remember how you tried to ruin the Spectacle in Gipat? The same is happening here: developments follow one another in a familiar rut, and to break free of the fetters you must go against the flow.
You must return to the aviaks and play their war games according to their rules until you see an opportunity to derail the narrative and send it careening down a different track. You will see success right away, as every new breach will create new holes, each of which could be used to return to the real world. But don't tarry, either: however well you may hide, sooner or later Tep will want to know who's shooting his toy full of holes.
Well, have you found golem pieces?
How lovely, how antiquated! Now wait for a moment, my... erm... colleague and I need to study it.
It's been almost a century since my name day, but I have never met creatures like yourself.

quests: Neither on Foot nor on Wings

t:
What a delicate taste and flavor! I...What's going on? I start... recalling!
O, the Ancients! O, glorious Genlun! Forgive us, your imprudent children! What a shame...

quests: Neither on Foot nor on Wings

t:
Take a look around. What you see before you is Tequatl - the only settlement of our ancient nation. Its beauty rivals that of mandarin flowers in spring, though it cannot compare with the beauty of a city on the ruins of which it was built and whose name it bears.
Tequatl was the city of the Ancients. They were all-knowing, all-powerful and wielded great magic. The Ancients knew how to make rock come alive. They were masters of the heavens and the earth. Our small nation was like a younger sibling to them, and we lived our lives without worry. Only vague legends remain of those wonderful times.
The Ancients had a sworn enemy. A monster from the Void which cannot be described: even the words are scared of him and fall to silence. Who he was and where he came from is beyond our grasp. The Enemy was so powerful that all of the Ancients' wisdom and magic wasn't enough to protect them. Before they perished, in their dying moments the Ancients made sure to save us, their children and heirs. We have built our own Tequatl on the ruins of the great Tequatl of the Ancients. Thus began a new era for my people - an era of darkness and solitude. We dug roots and hunted mice, learned to build fires and sew simple rough garments for wear. Long were those days, and filled with sorrow. So thunderous was the Tekyans' cry of despair that the world split into two!
But everything changed when They came. The true gods appeared to our people. They have built their palace on the mountain and settled there. They taught our people to build houses, sew beautiful clothing from soft fabrics, and cook delicious food. And all they asked in return was our devotion. The gods are powerful, righteous and kind. And if you prove your faith, you too may experience their favor!

quests: Neither on Foot nor on Wings

t: Oh... You're telling me the Tekyans are worshipping those ugly mugs? For shame! If only I were still alive...

I gladly give you my blessing! My blessing to banish those wicked beings, and to beat some sense into and return my people to tradition! And tell them something else from me personally: I forgive them for their past misdeeds, but if they're going to continue to neglect their ancestors' graves, I vow to haunt them every night. With sighs. Loud and with rebuke.

Hey, friend! Congratulations, we've won! The illusory world has been destroyed, Tep is dead, all the captives are free and sucking on lollipops in celebration of their release. Everyone is happy, dancing and laughing. Ha ha ha!
But really, you're about to meet your end. And the Resistance will follow suit in an hour. I betrayed you all, muahahaha! I may be a simple sailor, but I know which side the bread is buttered on! Say we are going to defeat Tep... then what? Back to Kania to mop ship decks? But here I can be anyone - a hero, a ladies' man, even a dragon! Instead of dry salted beef I can feast on barbequed Tekyans or spicy aviak wings. I can become an Immortal! Pity, this fate is not for you. Indeed, your fate is death!
He he he. I told you: it's good to control the illusion!
That island name Marai-Nui, you call it Crystal Mountain. It is taboo. You better not go there, not look, not even think. Ulumi Half-Wing broke the taboo once, flew there, and look at him now!
I'm a simple tanner. What do my wingless guest, a great warrior, need?
Better not ask. It's a bad place, a scary place. Nobody returned from there. Only Ulumi Half-Wing went there once and lost his mind. You better forget the Crystal Mountain forever.
I see, you have questions? Ask, don't be shy!
I know nothing about Crystal Mountain, Marai-Nui! A terrible place! Forbidden! One who asks questions is more inane than me, worse than a ropemaker! Stupid, stupid like Ulumi Half-Wing!

quests: If You Feel Like Riding, Go Get Some Lianas

t: Yes, wingless? Do you want to know how to make rope?

quests: If You Feel Like Riding, Go Get Some Lianas

t: You ask about Marai-Nui, Crystal Mountain? Why do you want to know? It's a scary place, very bad. Only Ulumi Half-Wing went there once and lost his mind!

I did not know! I have never even come close to abyss - old men say it is full of strange monsters! Nobody returned from there, only Ulumi Half-Wing. But he did not say anything, only frowned and coughed loud.
Marai-Nui, Crystal Mountain... You better never go there, never ask, not even look. Ulumi Half-Wing went there once, look at him now!
Kharr! And who are you? I do not know you! Go, go away!

t: Greetings! Be on your guard in the Holy Land, for danger is everywhere.

Ah, it looks like the capital has received my report! Well, they sent you... Let me look at you.

Pretty green, but there's visible enthusiasm already. In our business it's a must.

I guess Svetlana didn't say much when she sent you here, right?

Well, let's start with the basics. You are probably familiar with the canons of the Trinity Church. How Nezeb and Skrakan sacrificed their lives to close the demonic portal to another world, so the demonic threat was eliminated. Doubting this dogma is tantamount to heresy and treason, but you and I are outcasts anyway, right?

Listen to me very carefully: it seems that the demons weren't completely defeated! How so? I'm not sure, but there's an alarming level of activity on Asee-Teph. They are clearly planning something...

And no one can stop them but us.

You need to be ready. While you're getting settled here, complete the tasks of your commanders and wait. When you are certain you are well prepared, find me and let me know.
Alright, it looks like it really is time...
Good afternoon! Be on your guard in the Holy Land, for danger is everywhere.

Pretty green, but there's visible enthusiasm already. In our business it's a must.

I guess Vranomir didn't say much when he sent you here, right?

How Nezeb and Skrakan sacrificed their lives to close the demonic portal to another world, so the demonic threat was eliminated. Doubting this dogma is tantamount to heresy and treason, but you and I are outcasts anyway, right?

Alright, it looks like it really is time...
Interesting... And how does he expect me to execute this order if all my men are captured?
Oh... An order... I would have preferred a pot of porridge though.
Thank Tensess! What news do you have? Are we going to begin a general offensive soon?

The Doolga say we must shut ourselves in this Holy Land. The source of the power of the Illuminated is here, the thread that led to Howlem.

The eyes of all Sarnaut are fixed on this place. But this land is foreign to us. The spirits of these lands see us as strangers, and hunhurrs are not afraid of us, eysh.

The Doolga know what to do.

We must prove ourselves. To show the spirits of this earth who we are and what we stand for.

So we're going on the Great Hunt. We will strike down the most majestic animals of this land, we will prove that the Pridens are hunters, not prey.

Will you take part in this Hunt?
Here you go, make sure to read the entire thing!
Hello adventurer. Do you need something?
Excellent! We finally made it to the Holy Land!
That's good news, we're eager to get going!
Alright, it looks like it really is time...
Alright, it looks like it really is time...

Hah, this land is not so simple. It is an ancient land that once belonged to the June people. Their traces are everywhere, and the spirits of this place remember them. The Junes were the greatest hunters in the world who hunted down dragons. It won't be easy to match that, eysh.

Be careful, local enemies are much stronger. You shouldn't go hunting unless you're well prepared.

But the ritual needs to be carried out - we have to prove ourselves to earn the right to be here.
Alright, it looks like it really is time...
What's wrong? I don't know anything!
Hey, hey! It's good to see a friend in a place like this.

The Coba Plateau is the heart of all evil, I swear by the First, eysh.

But to be honest, I don't understand what's going on here. My gift speaks to me about three forms of evil. The ancient evil is Tep and his servants. They fought here and left their traces which are not erased even ten thousand years later.

The new evil that has emerged recently is the demons and their cultists. Places of Power are defiled. They only birth darkness now.

And finally, the future evil - the darkness that's going to consume the whole world... Where it comes from, I don’t know. But the danger is close, very close. I can feel it.

We need to complete the final ritual. Then perhaps the spirits of the Coba Plateau will give us answers.

Temper your will and prepare, then come find me.
Alright, it looks like it really is time...
Where are the others? Lost? Hehe, whoever finds it is in for a surprise!
The southern tomb can wave the curse
These magpies are trained to pick up loot and bring it to you. Very useful for a busy adventurer! You can buy one in the Boutique.

What? Are you going to interrogate me? Do you want me to reveal the secrets of our command?
Well, listen to me! Yasker has no secrets! He is a Great Mage, a disciple of Nezeb himself, hallowed be his name! Yasker is perfect! Do you understand? I doubt that. Your Tensess can't even be compared with our leader.
This is over. I won't tell you anything!

Stop! Calm down! Stop the violence!
What do you want to know? A Yasker's weak spot?
Hmm... Perhaps I'm the only one who can tell you something about that.
For a very long time I've been trying to understand why Yasker hates us, the Zem people. He keeps this secret safe, but I found the answer on an occasion. During my final exams one young necromancer demonstrated his abilities, and I saw how the Great Mage was trying to avoid the summoned creatures! You see?
He hates undead, their rotten flesh, their smell... And his disgust spreads on us, too!
What a fool! Why can't he see the difference? He's got to change his attitude, or soon he will be dethroned.

This thing...? This is just a piece of wood. You can throw it into the fire for all I care.
What really matters is kindness. I recently had a revelation and realized that the Empire has forgotten about mercy and goodness. The Kanians should be our brothers, but our soldiers kill them and the scientists use the defenseless prisoners in their experiments.
I had to put an end to this. And not simply with words, but with steel and fire!

Ah, so is that why you came? Yes, I replaced Nezeb's Staff with a fake, and those stupid scientists couldn't even tell the difference!
You ask who put me up to this? Only the Light! The true guidance that only faith in Tensess can bring!
The Light showed me the darkness of the state, and all of the bribery and corruption in it! Yet the officials turn a blind eye to it all, and do anything necessary to get ahead. Sooner or later this darkness WILL be dispelled, and then the evil defilers of the Empire will be cast down.
Soon, we will flee this corrupted land. The League will not leave us in our time of need, and their ships should be landing on the shores of the Empire any minute. We will return to Kania and gather our strength until the Empire can be defeated!

Here you go.
And remember, when we find my father, you and I fight the same battle.
You won't take me down without a fight!
Alright, I have called to them. If you want to ask them something, now is your chance.
I can't believe even those Servants of the Light can't figure this out! Holy smokes, what do I do now?
Excellent! Perfect! I'll prepare your ship in 5 minutes.
What do you want to know?
Congratulations! Your ship is ready to fly.
I am happy to give you a progress report. If you'd like to speed things along, ask me about the work being done on your ship.
Perfect! I'll make arrangements to start the construction right away. It's quite a long process, but I can tell you how to speed it up.

Demonology is a school of magic just like any elemental one. Or witchcraft, mysticism, necromancy...

The Church, of course, tried to impose penance: how dare we practice our foul arts! And rub elbows with demons to boot? They fuss over their Light like it’s the only thing that matters... Well, it’s their right as the high and mighty. But we’ll get even.

The Church wants you to eliminate demons? Wonderful. You’ll use their own weapons against them. Remember: demons are not our allies. They are no better than lab rats. Demons are a tool that will take us to a world of new magical opportunities, nothing more.
May Tensess, Nezeb and Skrakan protect you!

Oh, hi there! What are you saying?..

Oh, that's so nice of you! Thank you very much. It's good to know that you are remembered.

Me? I'm doing fine.

When it gets boring, I give the resurrected ones thumps in the head so that they think twice next time! You can't spread the Light without using your fists, you know.

But thank you. I mean it.
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
Exchange Equipment Refiners for Enigmatic Leather
Exchange Equipment Refiners for Ethereal Yarn
My name is Sarbaz Losash. I started studying alchemy a very long time ago, all the way back in my past life. I can tell you anything you need to know on the subject.
Hummer the Nimble is the name. What do you need?

No one but us blacksmiths can make plate armor. Also, we possess the art of forging rings. But first you'll have to practice making shields and various household implements.
Now, to the craft. Use a mobile forge to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore that should then be cast in the molds you need. As for rivets, chains, heeltaps and spikes, those can be obtained by fighting enemies.
The forging process is simple: you create five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the rest. You can only reforge each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you craft. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you. The highest available skill level in blacksmithing equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics. Also, we can create tools to work with equipment pieces and staples - you will need those at the highest development level.
By the way, if you ever need low-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while. Keep in mind, though, that retroform affects neither ore nor the goods made from it.

The result largely depends on how lucky you are. If you are lucky, you'll make an item of rare or even epic quality. Some tricks of our craft will let you considerably increase your chances.
If you got away with a smaller number of reforges, the leftover material will be enough to make an extra item of the same quality.
You can try making epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every blacksmith decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.
Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.
Exchange Disassembling Instructions for Enigmatic Leather
Exchange Disassembling Instructions for Ethereal Yarn
These records are of great value. Here, let me help you master the secrets of your profession.

No one but us leatherworkers can craft leather outfits. Plus, we can make earrings.
Now, about the process itself. Use a leatherworker's box to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. The ropes required for your work can be bought from me. You'll get the other components by fighting enemies. Clasps, laces, fringe and insets can be used as they are. As to leather fragments, you'll have to cut them with pincers first.

And most importantly: we can create Glyphs! Fight enemies at the Wild Shore and in the Astral to get required reagents. In order to create Glyphs of the highest quality, you will have to convert your Inspiration points into Illumination points. When the Illumination progress of a Glyph recipe reaches its maximum, you will be able to improve the quality of the produced Glyph.
By the way, if you ever need low-level components, you can use Retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while.

The result largely depends on how lucky you are. If you are lucky, you'll make an item of rare or even epic quality. Some tricks of our craft will let you considerably increase your chances.
First of all, work on improving your tools. This will allow you to get rid of faulty parts, reforge one part at a time, increase the maximum number of reforges to three, and even stimulate your inspiration. With your tools improved, half of the parts you make will be uncommon, a third will be rare, and only one-sixth of them will be epic. Upgrades can be bought from me.

No one but us tailors can craft clothes from fabric or make cloaks. Besides, we possess the knowledge how to make necklaces.
Now, about the process itself. Use a sewing kit to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. The threads required for your work can be bought from me. Buy Enhancements for the Weaponsmith's Tools
What designs would you like to buy?
Buy a manual from me and read it. Also, you'll need some tools. You can buy them from me or from the alchemy trainer.
Hi there. My name's Dogrose the Forester. Can I help you with anything related to herbalism?
What patterns would you like to buy?
